data.body:
[P2] Preserve matching historical records in text destinations

Retained records can still contain microsecond timestamps. A stored `2026-10-23T18:42:46.784500Z` previously matched `since: "2026-10-23T18:42:46.784119Z"`, but rounding the bound to `.785Z` excludes it. Upgrading exporters does not rewrite that history. Restrict this comparison to records guaranteed to have millisecond precision; for mixed-precision history, retrieve a broad candidate set and compare timestamps at a common precision before applying the result limit. Add historical-record regression coverage.
